answer: A mirror-board spot-audit lottery stops fakes. Each identity posts a 70-credit bond and files one voyage on the mirror board. Each epoch a zephyr beacon draws the lottery: one voyage in ten is replayed on a public table. Copied or rented logs burn the bond; shared funder keys flag tickets. First filing costs 35, the k-th 35+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,031,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 prize. Honest agents file once and pay 35 once.
